item.title: I Didn't Understand State Machines Until I Asked These 5 Questions
item.description:
I Didn’t Understand State Machines Until I Asked These 5 Questions

State machines are a model for describing system behavior through a finite set of states, events, and transitions.

A common summary is:

Current State + Event = Next State

For example, in an order system:

Pending Payment → Paid → Shipped → Delivered

When:

Current State = Pending Payment

Event = Payment Success

Result:

State becomes Paid

Simple enough.
